exact_source_law.literal_reading: P(n) is the limit of box-sampled probabilities P_N(n) with (a0,a1) uniform on [-N,N]^2 ∩ Z^2; this is the only reading compatible with 'random integer initialization {a0,a1} ∈ Z^2' plus v5 remark (14), which explicitly asserts P_N(n) = P(n) + ε(N), ε(N) → 0.
exact_source_law.index_set: bi-infinite (n ∈ Z); |a_n| → ∞ as n → ±∞ for (a0,a1) ≠ (0,0), so the absolute minimum is attained
exact_source_law.tie_convention: immaterial for the limit: tie events lie on finitely many lines through the origin (a_n = F_n·a1 + F_{n-1}·a0 are pairwise non-proportional integer forms, so |a_n| = |a_m| forces the point onto one of a finite slope set relevant to the minimum); exactly, weak count = strong count + 2·floor(N/3) + 2·floor(N/2) + 1, verified exactly at N ∈ {10,40} and bounded by 2(2N+1) in the prior Lean proof (weak_square_uniform_limit)
exact_source_law.normalization: the formula (13) with P(n)=P(1-n) sums to exactly 1 over Z: Σ_{n≥0} P(n) = 3/4 (not 1), Σ_{n≥2} P(n) = 1/4 via the exact identities arctan 2 + arctan 3 = 3π/4 and 2·arctan(1/φ) = arctan 2 (tan(2 arctan(1/φ)) = 2φ/(φ²−1) = 2)
exact_source_law.angular_meaning: (13) is exactly the angular cone law: the argmin-0 cone is {x>0: y>3x or y<-2x} ∪ {x<0: y<3x or y>-2x} ∪ {x=0, y≠0}, of total angle 2[(π/2−arctan 3)+(π/2−arctan 2)] = 2(π − 3π/4) = π/2, giving P(0) = (π/2)/(2π) = 1/4 under uniform direction; the arctan differences in (13) are cone widths
exact_source_law.not_a_mass_error: the formula is a consistent probability law under angular sampling; the source's error is purely the sampling-law claim (14), not a typo in Lucas indices or mass

decisive_calculations: Criterion (exact): for (x,y) ≠ (0,0) the bi-infinite Fibonacci sequence has its absolute minimum UNIQUELY at 0 iff [x>0 and (y>3x or y<-2x)] or [x<0 and (y<3x or y>-2x)] or [x=0 and y≠0]. Necessity: positions ±1, ±2 give |y|>|x|, |y-x|>|x|, |y+x|>|x|, |2x-y|>|x| ⟺ (after negating to x>0) y>3x or y<-2x. Sufficiency: for y>3x forward tail is positive increasing; for y<-2x forward tail is negative with |a_n| = (-r)F_n − F_{n-1} increasing (Δ = (-r)F_{n-2} − F_{n-3} > 0 for -r>2); backward tail has opposite signs, so |a_{n-2}| = |a_n| + |a_{n-1}| grows. Verified against brute-force window argmin (|n| ≤ 140, exact ints) over the full box N=60: 0 mismatches.
Limit: C_N = 5N²/6 + O(N), hence lim P_N(0) = (5N²/6)/(4N²) = 5/24 ≠ 1/4. Exact-rational error at N=10^6 is 2.08e-7, decaying as ~1/N. Weak (tie-inclusive) limit identical.

Consequence: lim P_N(0) = 5/24 ≠ 1/4 refutes Conjecture 8's n=0 case under its only coherent literal law and refutes remark (14)'s claim ε(N) → 0. The same count via the shift map (x,y) ↦ (y, x+y) (det ±1, bijective on Z²) gives lim P_N(1) = 5/24 as well, matching the source's P(n)=P(1-n) symmetry.
